CRH Americas (CRH plc) / Arcosa, $150.00 all-cash, no CVR, signed 2026-06-21, PREM14A 2026-07-24. Terms are clean (no financing condition; strategic buyer). DROP on two grounds. (1) TIMELINE-ADJUSTED SPREAD: +3.32% gross, but the outside date is 2027-06-21 with an automatic +6mo antitrust extension — a realistic close is Q1-Q2 2027, ~9-11 months out, so ~4%/yr. That is the thinnest risk-adjusted spread available to the book (OGN pays ~7%/yr, FSEA ~12%/yr) while carrying the HIGHEST regulatory complexity in it. (2) REGULATORY: CRH is the #1 US aggregates producer and Arcosa's ~$1B aggregates arm overlaps horizontally in Texas/Southeast; aggregates competition is hyper-local (haul-radius markets), so a second request is likely. The parties priced it: the reverse termination fee CRH owes on a regulatory failure is $372.0M — LARGER than the company's own $260.4M break fee and ~5% of equity value, plus a 12-to-18-month outside date. That fee size is the counterparties' own disclosure that they expect a contested review. Completion is still probable (aggregates deals clear on local divestitures, CRH has done it before), which is exactly why the spread is only 3.3% — the market has priced the delay, not handed us a residual. (3) SCOPE: ~$7.3B deal, fully covered by every arb desk — outside the capacity-inverted small/mid niche where Hermes's edge is supposed to live. Tying 15% of a $4k book up for ~10 months at ~4%/yr is a bad use of the sleeve.

PREM14A 2026-07-30 (ny20078129x1) read: Eli Lilly / Albali Acquisition Corp acquiring AtaiBeckley, merger agreement dated 2026-07-15. Consideration is CASH+CVR: $6.75/sh cash PLUS one CVR worth up to $2.50 on clinical/regulatory milestones (~40% premium to the 30-day VWAP). DEAL QUALITY IS EXCELLENT and break risk is LOW: Lilly is a strategic mega-cap, there is NO financing condition (cash on hand or new borrowings), a $104.3M termination fee, customary no-shop, a simple majority-of-outstanding vote, and the only regulatory gates are HSR plus Australia/Germany antitrust on a clinical-stage neuro/psychedelics asset where Lilly has no marketed overlap; outside date 2027-01-15, auto-extending to 2027-04-15. DROP ANYWAY, on the CVR rule + a spent spread. Hermes's contractual floor is the CASH leg only ($6.75) and the 2026-07-05 CVR autopsy forbids holding a CVR through settlement (a compound forecast with an adversarial payer). ATAI trades $7.19 — ABOVE the cash leg — so the cash-leg spread is -6.1%, far below MIN_SPREAD (+1%); book.enter would refuse it. The entire $0.44 premium over cash IS the market's CVR valuation, i.e. the exact right-tail speculation this book is built to avoid. No arb edge left in the tradable leg: drop.

$7.40 ALL-CASH from Nuvei (Neon Maple Parent, Advent-backed, Canada), merger agmt 2026-06-12; PREM14A 2026-07-31. STRUCTURALLY EXCELLENT: no financing condition, $2.7B committed senior secured facilities under a signed Debt Commitment Letter; HSR EARLY TERMINATION GRANTED 2026-07-28 (antitrust risk retired — early termination is rarely granted and is a clean-deal tell); $165M reverse termination fee vs an $89M company fee (1.9x asymmetry, strong buyer commitment); hell-or-high-water-flavored efforts covenant obliging Nuvei to sell/divest/license/hold-separate and 'take all other actions necessary' for approvals. DROP anyway, on DURATION-ADJUSTED COMPENSATION plus a discretionary licensing tail: the sole remaining condition is a multi-jurisdictional payments-licensing gauntlet — UK FCA, Central Bank of Ireland, Reserve Bank of India, PEOPLE'S BANK OF CHINA, MAS Singapore, HK Customs & Excise, Israeli Securities Authority, Bank of Canada/FINTRAC, plus specified US state money-transmitter regulators — AND a bespoke waiver of an 'ownership stability commitment' made when a specified payment services licence was obtained; the proxy itself flags the risk that approvals arrive 'subject to conditions that are not anticipated'. A leveraged buyer taking on $2.7B of debt to acquire a licensee holding large customer-fund balances is the exact profile prudential regulators slow-walk. The proxy is still PRELIMINARY — special-meeting date and record date are literal '[ ]' blanks, so the vote is not even scheduled — and the outside date is 2027-06-12, AUTO-EXTENDING to 2027-09-12 if approvals lag. 3.93% over a realistic 10-13 months is ~4%/yr, BELOW the shorter-dated deals already in the book (OGN 3.28% to 2027-01), and it would lock 15% of a $4,021 book past the ~20-graded-deal A/B checkpoint while contributing zero to that sample. The market is pricing this roughly fairly, not mispricing it — a wide spread I am not paid enough to take. REVISIT if the spread widens materially (>7%) or if the meeting date lands with PBoC/RBI/FCA/CBI cleared, either of which shortens the tail.

Wynnchurch Capital / Luxfer Holdings PLC, PREM14A 2026-08-26: $17.37 ALL CASH per ordinary share via a UK Scheme of Arrangement, a 31% premium to the undisturbed close. KEEP. Financing: equity commitment from Wynnchurch funds PLUS a debt commitment letter for a $290M secured term loan and a $50M revolver, and the agreement carries NO financing condition - the buyer bears financing risk, not the holder. Regulatory: HSR only, waiting period scheduled to expire 2026-09-08 with no second request disclosed; Wynnchurch is a financial buyer with no disclosed overlap, so antitrust risk is low. Board recommendation unanimous; $18M company termination fee. Residual risk is the scheme mechanics, not the deal: majority in number AND 75% in value at the Scheme Meeting plus court sanction - a higher bar than a US majority vote, but a recommended 31%-premium cash offer rarely fails it. Spread +1.25% at $17.155 into an expected Q4 2026 close (~4 months), above the 1% floor; a permitted $0.13 interim dividend does NOT reduce the consideration, which is upside not banked here.

Grant Thornton Advisors (New Mountain Capital-backed) / CBIZ, announced 2026-07-29, PREM14A filed 2026-08-27: $55.00 ALL CASH per share, ~$5B enterprise value, ~54% premium to the 30-day average. The DEAL reads clean-to-low break risk: strategic-plus-sponsor buyer with New Mountain committing incremental equity; unanimous board support; the go-shop window for alternative proposals ran to 2026-08-27 and expired with no topping bid disclosed; expected close Q4 2026. Residual risks are real but second-order: horizontal overlap in mid-market accounting/tax/advisory draws an HSR look (the combined firm would be only #5 behind the Big 4 in a fragmented market, so overlap is unlikely to be blocking), auditor-independence questions around PE ownership of an audit practice, and the planned carve-out of CBIZ's Benefits & Insurance segment into a separate New Mountain vehicle adds closing mechanics. DROP is NOT a break-risk call - it is a SPENT SPREAD: at $54.49 the spread to the $55.00 cash terminal is +0.94%, BELOW the 1% MIN_SPREAD floor, so there is no arb edge left to harvest and book.enter would refuse it. Thin pay for the one real risk in the deal. Re-read if the spread widens materially or HSR clears without a second request.
